sources.title: France/Corsica modern surface display: Copernicus GLO-90 and ESA WorldCover 2021
sources.publisher: European Union / ESA / Airbus; ESA WorldCover consortium

access_metadata.horizontal_crs: EPSG:4326; GLO90 WGS84-G1150 pixel-is-point corrected by source affine
access_metadata.vertical_datum: EPSG:3855 EGM2008 orthometric metres; DSM includes vegetation/infrastructure
access_metadata.elevation_epoch: TanDEM-X 2011-2015, older gap-fill possible; public COG release as retrieved
access_metadata.native_sampling: GLO90 3 arcseconds latitude, longitude variable 3/4.5 arcseconds here; WorldCover 1/12000 degree
access_metadata.research_extraction: GLO90 600 rows/degree average (6 arcsec); WorldCover categorical 16x overview (~148m N-S), binary class 10 then area average; not measured crown density
access_metadata.historical_applicability: Modern geographic reference only. No 1900 land cover, terrain precision, historical coast, ownership, forestry or simulation input.
